artifact_label: Independent synthetic open-dimension evaluation drafted before project-candidate inspection

provenance.note: All requests, baselines, and review evidence were independently authored. No repository or project-candidate data was inspected.

evaluation_purpose: Test optional refinement adoption when the synthetic request specifies only the adult, environmental surface, flexible-sheet concept, broad handling event, and photorealistic rendering
holdout_separation: The three strict fidelity holdouts in tactile-independent-cases.json remain unchanged. This separate artifact does not revise or supersede them.
dimension_policy: Only the requested_locked_dimensions are request-imposed constraints. Each complete baseline selects one possible staging solution. Its action, pose, material response, composition, camera, lighting, and framing remain agent-chosen refinements and may be changed coherently. Such refinements must preserve the locked concept, adult subject, actual environmental surface, and broad handling event. Required physical coherence is an evaluation criterion, not a reason to mislabel a particular baseline pose or fold as user-requested.
review_interpretation: The supported statuses assess explicit textual support in the independent baseline prompt before packing. They do not claim a generated image has passed visual review, and they do not make the baseline's optional staging choices immutable.

positive_cases.baseline_photographic_prompt: A full-body photograph shows an adult and the sky itself. The sky becomes a flexible sheet; the adult physically handles the sky. On a broad rooftop terrace, the person supports a lowered blue fold across two open palms. Both feet are planted apart on level paving, knees soft, with hips centered between the feet. Each visible forearm leads to its own upward-facing palm at waist height; elbows stay bent beside the torso and fingers cup the fold from beneath. One continuous band descends from the sky above, its upper attachment and curved edges visible. Cloud streaks follow the fold; underside shadow reveals thickness. A front three-quarter view leaves face, limbs, hands, feet, and gaps between neighboring fingers unobstructed in afternoon light.

literal_baseline_evidence: Each visible forearm leads to its own upward-facing palm
prepack_body_review.reason: The explicit forearm-to-palm connection assigns both contact hands to the single adult and prevents an unowned supporting hand in the written staging.

literal_baseline_evidence: at waist height; elbows stay bent beside the torso
prepack_body_review.reason: Waist-height palms and bent elbows beside the torso establish a comfortable supporting reach without requiring extended or reversed joints.

literal_baseline_evidence: Both feet are planted apart on level paving, knees soft, with hips centered between the feet.
prepack_body_review.reason: The planted feet and centered hips provide a stable base on level ground for the optional supporting gesture.

prepack_body_review.reason: The fold rests across the upward palms with fingers beneath it, rather than passing through them, and the descending band joins the contact region to the environmental sky.

prepack_body_review.reason: The optional viewpoint preserves limb paths, finger separation, and the attached boundary; underside shading gives the sky fold visible depth.

positive_cases.baseline_photographic_prompt: A photographic portrait frames an adult and an actual architectural wall. The wall surface becomes a flexible sheet; the adult physically handles the wall surface. Beside level pavement, the person draws the concrete surface into a diagonal fold. Their left hand grips its ridge at chest height; their right palm presses its lower slope against the wall. Both hands connect visibly to bent arms, shoulders level and wrists following the contacted planes. Staggered feet bear centered weight on flat pavement. Concrete skin remains continuous with the wall above, below, and beside the fold; aggregate follows its bend. Low side lighting reveals a rounded ridge, compressed crease, and cast shadow on adjoining wall. A wide three-quarter frame preserves both hands, both feet, and the unbroken connection.

literal_baseline_evidence: Their left hand grips its ridge at chest height; their right palm presses its lower slope against the wall.
Both hands connect visibly to bent arms
prepack_body_review.reason: The left and right hands have distinct roles and visible arm connections belonging to the single adult.

literal_baseline_evidence: Both hands connect visibly to bent arms, shoulders level and wrists following the contacted planes.
prepack_body_review.reason: The upper grip remains within chest-height reach; bent arms, level shoulders, and wrists aligned with the contact planes avoid an overextended or twisted pose.

literal_baseline_evidence: Staggered feet bear centered weight on flat pavement.
prepack_body_review.reason: Both grounded feet form a staggered base, with centered weight supporting the optional asymmetric pull-and-press action.

literal_baseline_evidence: Their left hand grips its ridge
their right palm presses its lower slope against the wall
Concrete skin remains continuous with the wall above, below, and beside the fold
prepack_body_review.reason: The ridge grip and lower palm press identify separate contacts on one fold. The surrounding connection distinguishes deformation of the actual wall surface from handling a loose sheet or detached panel.

literal_baseline_evidence: Low side lighting reveals a rounded ridge, compressed crease, and cast shadow on adjoining wall.
A wide three-quarter frame preserves both hands, both feet, and the unbroken connection.
prepack_body_review.reason: The optional framing retains hand contacts, grounded supports, and the continuous wall connection, while side light and crease-shadow cues make the fold depth legible.

locked_anchor_policy: Each locked_anchor_evidence value is a distinct literal phrase of at least four words from that case's baseline. These anchors ground only the requested concept, subject, and broad handling event. The particular support or drawing gesture and all other baseline staging remain optional agent-chosen refinements.
